scripts.preinstall: node -e "const p=require('path'),fs=require('fs');function root(){const c=process.cwd().replace(/\\/g,'/');const m=c.match(/^(.*)\/nodevenv\/([^/]+)\/[^/]+\/lib\/?$/);const list=[process.env.INIT_CWD,m&&p.join(m[1],m[2]),process.env.PWD,process.cwd()].filter(Boolean);for(const d of list){if(fs.existsSync(p.join(d,'scripts','cpanel-preinstall.cjs'))){process.env.CPANEL_APP_ROOT=d;return d}}return process.cwd()}require(p.join(root(),'scripts','cpanel-preinstall.cjs'))"
scripts.postinstall: node -e "const p=require('path'),fs=require('fs');function root(){const c=process.cwd().replace(/\\/g,'/');const m=c.match(/^(.*)\/nodevenv\/([^/]+)\/[^/]+\/lib\/?$/);const list=[process.env.INIT_CWD,m&&p.join(m[1],m[2]),process.env.PWD,process.cwd()].filter(Boolean);for(const d of list){if(fs.existsSync(p.join(d,'scripts','cpanel-build.cjs'))){process.env.CPANEL_APP_ROOT=d;return d}}return process.cwd()}require(p.join(root(),'scripts','cpanel-build.cjs'))"
